description:
[Calculators] Explosives needed to destroy a set of building pieces. The raid calculator page's plan (https://rust.wiki/calculators/raid). Targets are building pieces (slugs from
/building), doors, hatches, high walls and other deployables (slug or item shortname, e.g. `door.hinged.metal`).
`plan` is what the page shows: per piece every allowed explosive's count and sulfur, the cheapest single
explosive, and the cheapest MIX when combining explosives saves sulfur; then the totals - `total_sulfur`,
`explosives_to_craft` (with crafts for batch recipes) and `raw_resources` - and a `page` link to the same plan.
`options` / `cheapest` are single-explosive totals over every piece at once (one explosive for the whole raid).
Deployables the building data lacks (auto turrets, boxes, tool cupboards, furnaces...: item shortname or name)
come back under `game_data_deployables`, from the server files: per target every explosive's `count`, `sulfur`
and `cheapest`, plus `single_explosive_totals`. Doors, hatches and high walls go in by slug or item shortname (door.hinged.metal); any other deployable (autoturret, box.wooden.large, cupboard.tool...) comes back under game_data_deployables. Use `plan` for the answer the raid calculator page gives (cheapest explosive or mix per piece, totals).

explosives.description: `staples` (rockets, C4, satchels, explosive ammo, beancans), `all`, or a comma list of explosive shortnames.

mode.description: `mix` (the page's default: mixing explosives on a piece when that saves sulfur) or `single` (one explosive per piece).

targets.description: Comma-separated `slug:count` building pieces (slugs from /building, or display names).

name: calculate_raid_cost
title: Explosives needed to destroy a set of building pieces
